calls.query: mambo ni matatu OR Kasarani Kick OR si ulisema

writer.short_answer: Three things keep coming up in Kenyan feeds: the mambo ni matatu line, the Kasarani Kick sound and the si ulisema reply.

claims.text: The line mambo ni matatu is used for a chaotic day that still keeps moving, and it started in skits and spread to X.
claims.label: single_source

quotes.text: the new way to say things are chaotic

claims.text: The Kasarani Kick sound is on TikTok challenges and in matatu speaker talk on X, and it is still being posted this week.
claims.label: single_source

claims.text: The line mambo ni matatu is also said in clubs, as one post on TikTok shows.
claims.label: single_source

claims.text: Posts warn that a brand using these lines in an ad looks forced, and one compares the Kasarani Kick from a brand to an uncle at a wedding.
claims.label: single_source

so_what.text: A brand should join the Kasarani Kick as a fan, not as an advertiser.
